protected_acceptance_map.title: Canonical branch derivation is exact
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: For canonical Project/run identity and accepted lineage `src:<64hex>`, the helper returns exactly `parallax/{project8}-{run8}-{lineage64}` using all 64 lineage hexadecimal characters.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Malformed identity fails closed
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Malformed Project identity, run identity, missing/invalid `src:` lineage prefix, non-hex lineage data, or wrong lineage length cannot produce a publication branch.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Ordinary delivery uses shared lineage branch
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: `VerifiedLineageDelivery` publishes an accepted lineage on the shared canonical lineage-scoped branch and preserves all existing repository/commit/PR/Preview verification.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Greenfield delivery uses the same shared lineage branch
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: `GreenfieldVerifiedLineageDelivery` uses the identical helper and format after its existing P2-V0.23.42 delivery-base classification. No greenfield-specific branch naming remains.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Same-run replacement receives a distinct branch
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Two valid accepted lineages for the same Project/run deterministically derive distinct branch names while retaining identical Project/run prefixes.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Prior branch is untouched
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Publishing the replacement lineage performs no mutation/delete/force update against the earlier lineage's existing branch, PR or Preview.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Durable replay is unchanged
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: If the exact accepted lineage already has a durable delivery record, delivery returns that record before branch creation and preserves the stored historical branch identity.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Unexpected computed branch conflict remains fail-closed
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: If the canonical lineage-scoped branch exists unexpectedly without exact durable delivery-record authority, provider conflict remains a hard failure. No automatic reuse or alternate branch is attempted.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Delivery records remain exact lineage authority
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Record keys, accepted lineage/content digests, exact Git commit/PR/Preview read-back and replay semantics remain lineage-bound and unchanged except that a newly persisted result records the canonical lineage-scoped branch.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Protected release gates pass
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The exact spec passes validation plus authentic DSPy SpecCritic/SpecCompiler and strict compiled-plan validation before semantic implementation. Focused tests, full API regression, Bounded Autonomy, Workstream Spec Validation and P2 CI pass on exact reviewed heads.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Production acceptance
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The exact merged API source reaches production READY with normal preflights, `/health` and `/ready` HTTP 200 and reviewed exact-deployment runtime scans. Frozen W9-S1 run `a64d56b7-ad42-42ad-9562-891783363f4a` at REVIEW revision 12 retries publication of replacement lineage `src:001736ab731e243956cf78ede7a0087d2b81595f1008568850eac1e9acc3e809`. The retry must: - not recur `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH`; - not recur `BRANCH_CONFLICT` against prior branch `parallax/0e20392b-a64d56b7`; - create/read a new canonical lineage-scoped feature branch for the replacement lineage; - create/read the exact replacement-lineage commit and a new GitHub PR; - create/read a READY Vercel Preview or existing bounded READY-equivalent result under normal delivery semantics; - preserve the original branch and QA PR #1 unchanged; - leave the Engineering Run at human REVIEW revision 12 with `last_failure_code=null`. Any genuinely later independent blocker is recorded separately rather than weakening this boundary.

critique: The source-publication identity defect exposed after P2-V0.23.42 successfully admitted an ordinary commit-bearing empty repository. Distinct accepted source lineages in the same Engineering Run must receive distinct deterministic feature branches so bounded REVIEW rework can publish a replacement candidate without rewriting, deleting, or reusing the branch that represents an earlier reviewed lineage. The change must be shared by ordinary and greenfield accepted-source delivery, preserve exact durable delivery replay for an already-published lineage, and leave every prior branch, pull request, Preview, default branch, merge boundary, and human REVIEW decision untouched.
